Package com.robojacks.robot.subsystems

Class Vision

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.command.SubsystemBase
com.robojacks.robot.subsystems.Vision
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subsystem
public class Vision extends SubsystemBase
Vision, the way FRC robots do it with PhotonVision: the GPS Sensor is the "camera", a GpsPoseEstimator turns its readings into pose estimates, and each estimate goes to the drive subsystem's pose estimator through the consumer passed in. The GPS's mounting is VisionConstants.kRobotToGps: a robot-to-camera transform from the robot's center in WPILib's robot coordinates. 

 private final Vision m_vision = new Vision(m_robotDrive::addVisionMeasurement);
